Winds of up to 84 miles (135 kilometers) an hour were recorded in Argyll and Bute in western Scotland, and fallen trees and power cables blocked roads and rail lines across the country. More than 82,000 homes in Britain, nearly 60,000 in France and at least 10,000 in Germany had power cuts inflicted by the passage of storms Boelo and Austen within 24 hours of each other, authorities in the countries said. Britain's Energy Networks Association indicated that more than 400,000 homes had lost power at some stage during the storms.
